title: Layer 3 round 1 major security: state-sourced display strings reach the terminal uncleaned — live escape and newline injection through the segment and human form

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed in ff331dd9: clean_for_terminal at the render boundary — the segment and human form drop control characters from every interpolated value, state-sourced strings included; an ESC or newline in adopter-edited state.yaml renders as data. Pinned: the hostile-state fixture asserts no escape byte reaches either surface and the one-line invariant holds. The machine form is JSON (serde escapes; inert there by construction).
